speaker: Doctor
text: Given your work with livestock and the specific distribution of symptoms, have you noticed any lesions on your wrists, elbows, or between your fingers? Do you experience worse itching at night, and has anyone else in your household developed similar symptoms?

text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.
